query: 产品回收率 产品回收率 衡量企业在报告期内，因安全、健康等潜在风险而必须执行回收的受影响产品数量，占同期已售或已运送产品总数的百分比。 A. 数据透明度得分 (权重 50%) 2分：清晰披露了回收百分比，或明确声明本期“回收率为 0%”。 1分：仅定性描述有/无回收，未给出具体的百分比或产品基数。 0分：未披露任何回收相关数据。 B. 统计口径得分 (权重 50%) 2分：说明了计算口径（如涵盖的所有产品线）及回收原因（如技术缺陷、标签错误）。 1分：仅给出一个孤立的数字，无背景说明。 0分：无说明。 最终得分 = 0.5×A+0.5×B 产品召回率 召回百分比 产品召回数量 已售产品数量 已运送产品数量 零召回 未发生产品召回 安全原因召回 健康风险召回 缺陷产品召回 标签错误召回 product recall rate percentage of products recalled recalled units units sold units shipped zero recalls no product recalls safety-related recall health-related recall defective product recall mislabeling recall 报告期内是否定性说明发生或未发生产品召回？ 是否披露因安全、健康、技术缺陷或标签错误召回的产品占已售或已运送产品的百分比，或明确声明召回率为0%？ 召回数量、已售/已运送数量及计算公式是什么？ 召回原因和产品范围是什么？ 报告期与统计边界是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '产品回收率'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 报告期内是否定性说明发生或未发生产品召回？ 是否披露因安全、健康、技术缺陷或标签错误召回的产品占已售或已运送产品的百分比，或明确声明召回率为0%？ 召回数量、已售/已运送数量及计算公式是什么？ 召回原因和产品范围是什么？ 报告期与统计边界是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“本期无重大召回”无比例；仅有召回制度而无数量占比；循环经济产品回收再利用率；仅有客户退货率；区分：尽管指标名含“回收率”，定义实为安全/健康原因召回数量占比，不是循环经济回收利用率；召回程序看制度完备性；本指标看量化比率或0%声明。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group procures raw materials from the market for producing magnesium metal and magnesium alloys. results.section: Commercial morality / B8: Community Investment
results.text: The Group continues its innovation efforts, and has increased its investments in research and development. It also optimises the production procedures and operation regulations. We will consolidate our resources and pay attention to the development of the magnesium alloy business, striving to become China's largest leading magnesium product enterprise and building the premier magnesium technology industrial platform. Against the backdrop of 'Green Economy', magnesium new materials will have greater development potential amid the lightweight trend in automobile production. The Group will also strive to contribute to energy-saving and lightweight development. In the post-epidemic era, we believe that magnesium products will continue to show its charm and further establish solid confidence amongst consumers. It is foreseen that the magnesium industry is launching a new era with good prospects for development!

results.text: The coal gasification is used by the Group to eliminate outdated equipment, in a bid to generate clean energy for production. With the application of regenerative high-temperature combustion technologies, the exhaust gas temperature is significantly reduced and the overall thermal efficiency is increased by over 50%, thereby mitigating air pollution.
